my_own_false_positive_disclosed: My first pass flagged the Etsy kit as lacking a legal disclaimer because it searched for the literal phrase 'not legal advice'. The PDF actually words it 'it is not professional, financial, or legal advice'. The product was always correctly scoped; the search term was wrong. Corrected and re-verified before reporting.

reasons: Problem clarity: a suspension is painful, urgent and time-boxed - a 30/60-day appeal window. The buyer is already searching and already stressed, which is the strongest buying state available here.
Identifiable buyer: a suspended Etsy seller is easy to name, unlike a general compliance audience.
Delivery readiness: 19 pages / 2,639 words, 11 checklists, verified downloadable, no guarantees, explicit non-guarantee of outcome, no fabricated citations.

Price friction: with 0 sales and 0 reviews there is no social proof, so a $155 first purchase faces the worst possible trust-to-risk ratio. A $29 first purchase does not. Price alone did not decide this - it is one of eight weighed criteria.

Distribution fit is already proven for this product specifically: its Telegraph article is among the best-read in the account (7 observed views, tied in the top group) and three guide pages plus one blog now carry attributed disclosures pointing to it.

alternative.why_not_primary: strongest external demand evidence and the freshest distribution (a new Telegraph article), but at $155 with no reviews it carries the highest friction of the three. It stays the secondary bet and the long-term anchor.

explicitly_not_chosen.legal_case_research_automation: verified clean and a legitimate product, but 'make legal research faster' is an optimisation, not a deadline. No urgency, so no reason to buy today.

commercial_experiment.audience: A seller whose Etsy shop has just been suspended and who is inside the appeal window
commercial_experiment.channel: The existing, already-live free surfaces for this product - Telegraph article (7 observed views, top of account), and the three guide/blog pages carrying attributed disclosures. NOT a new mass publication: the channel for this product already exists and duplicating it would be noise.

commercial_experiment.success_criterion: at least 1 completed order, or at least 1 attributable free-copy lead from this product

commercial_experiment.if_no_response: do NOT conclude the product is unwanted. With 238 total observed views across the whole catalogue and zero orders everywhere, a weak response here is more likely to indicate a payment-path or trust problem than a product-demand problem, and I will say so rather than re-publish.
